common.noMatch: Nothing matches. Try other words or clear the filter.
common.noAccessTitle: Your Books role does not include this section
common.noAccessBody: An admin of the workspace can change your role in Books › Settings › Roles.

roles.accountantDesc: everything: sales, purchases, banking, journal, reports and settings.
roles.salesDesc: invoices, credit notes and customers. No purchases, banking or reports.
roles.viewerDesc: reads everything, reports included, and changes nothing.

overview.title: Books
overview.desc: What customers owe you, what you owe, and how the month is going.
overview.setupTitle: {n, plural, one {One step left to start invoicing} other {# steps left to start invoicing}}

setup.company: Add your company name and address
setup.payments: Connect Stripe or Mercado Pago to get paid online

docs.search: Search by number, reference or contact

invoice.desc: Invoices to your customers, from draft to paid.
invoice.emptyBody: Create an invoice, send it by email with a link to pay, and Books keeps the journal up to date.

credit_note.desc: Credit notes correct an issued invoice. Create one from the invoice.
credit_note.emptyBody: Open an issued invoice and choose Create credit note.

bill.desc: Invoices from your suppliers, with due dates and payments.
bill.emptyBody: Record what your suppliers invoice you to know what you owe and when.

editor.dueHelp: Leave it empty to count the terms from the issue date.
editor.fxHelp: Set by hand. Books has no automatic rate feed.
editor.approveHelp: Approving assigns the number and posts the journal entry. After that the document can't be edited: correct it with a credit note or void it.
editor.deleteBody: Drafts have no number or journal entry, so nothing else changes.
editor.sendHelp: The email has a link to view, download and pay. You can revoke the link at any time.
editor.paymentFx: Exchange rate on the payment day ({base} per 1 {cur})
editor.voidBody: Books posts a reversing journal entry. The number stays used and the document stays in the list as void.
editor.linkOff: The public link is off. Nobody can open it.

contacts.desc: Customers and suppliers, with their tax ID and terms.
contacts.importDesc: Bring a CRM company in as a customer or supplier. They stay linked.
contacts.crmEmpty: No CRM companies left to import.
contacts.search: Search by name, email or tax ID
contacts.emptyBody: Add your customers and suppliers, or import them from the CRM.
contacts.name: Name or business name
contacts.countryHelp: AR, MX, BR… Sets which tax ID is checked.
contacts.taxIdHelp: CUIT, RFC, CNPJ and CPF are checked with their check digit.
contacts.openCrm: Open the company in the CRM
contacts.noDocuments: No documents with this contact yet.
contacts.deleteBody: If they have documents, Books archives them instead so the documents keep their data.

items.desc: Products and services with price, cost and stock.
items.emptyBody: Add what you sell and buy to fill invoice lines in one click.
items.name: Name
items.linkShopHelp: If you also sell it in Shop, link it so both apps share the same stock.
items.deleteBody: If it is used in documents, Books archives it instead.

expenses.desc: Receipts and card or cash expenses, by category.
expenses.newDesc: Upload the receipt and Books can read the amount, date and vendor for you.
expenses.emptyBody: Record expenses with their receipt to keep the P&L and tax credit up to date.
expenses.taxHelp: Leave it empty and Books calculates it from the rate.
expenses.receiptHelp: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF up to 10 MB. Only people with Books can open it.
expenses.aiHelp: Fills amount, date and vendor in the form. Check them and save. Uses your workspace AI quota.
expenses.aiFilled: Fields filled from the receipt. Check them and save.
expenses.deleteBody: The draft and its receipt are deleted.
expenses.voidBody: Books posts a reversing journal entry and the expense stays as void.

po.desc: Orders to your suppliers. Receiving them adds stock.
po.emptyBody: Order from suppliers, receive what arrives and turn it into a bill.
po.cancelBody: Only orders with nothing received can be cancelled.
po.receiveHelp: Items with stock add what you receive. Linked Shop items add it in Shop.
po.billOrdered: Create bill for what was ordered
po.billReceived: Create bill for what was received

recurring.desc: Invoices that Books creates on a schedule.
recurring.emptyBody: Subscriptions, retainers, rent: set it once and Books issues each period.
recurring.name: Name
recurring.extraLines: {n, plural, one {Plus one more line from the original template.} other {Plus # more lines from the original template.}}
recurring.help: Each invoice is approved when it is created. Books checks every hour.

quotes.desc: CRM quotes sent or accepted that are not invoiced yet.
quotes.emptyBody: When a CRM quote is sent or accepted it shows up here.
quotes.noCrmBody: Quotes live in the CRM. Ask an admin for access to bring them into Books.

banking.desc: Bank and cash accounts, statements and reconciliation.
banking.noFeeds: Books has no live bank feeds. Download the statement from your bank as CSV or OFX and import it.
banking.emptyBody: Add your bank accounts to import statements and reconcile them.
banking.name: Name
banking.currencyNote: The account uses your base currency, {currency}.
banking.imported: {n} lines imported, {dup} already there, {err} with errors
banking.importHelp: CSV with date, description and amount (or debit and credit) columns, or an OFX file. Lines already imported are skipped.
banking.noTxnsBody: Import a CSV or OFX statement from your bank.
banking.deleteBody: If it has movements, Books archives it instead.

accounts.desc: Your chart of accounts. Accounts used by automatic entries can be renamed but not removed.
accounts.name: Name

journal.desc: Every double-entry journal entry, from documents and by hand.
journal.newDesc: Debits and credits must be equal to post it.
journal.emptyBody: Entries appear when you approve invoices, bills, expenses and payments.
journal.unbalanced: Difference of {diff}. Debits and credits must match.
journal.title: Entry #{n}
journal.reverseBody: Books posts a new entry with the same amounts on the opposite side.
journal.immutable: Entries are never edited. To correct one, reverse it.

reports.desc: Built from the journal, in your base currency.

pnl.title: Profit and loss
pnl.desc: Income, costs and expenses for a period.

balance.title: Balance sheet
balance.desc: Assets, liabilities and equity on a date.

cashflow.title: Cash flow
cashflow.desc: Money in and out of your bank and cash accounts.

agedReceivables.title: Aged receivables
agedReceivables.desc: What each customer owes and how late it is.

agedPayables.title: Aged payables
agedPayables.desc: What you owe each supplier and how late it is.

tax.title: Sales tax
tax.desc: Tax on sales and purchases by rate, with the VAT books.

reports.cashHelp: Direct method over bank, cash and payments in transit accounts.
reports.taxHelp: {sales} sales documents and {purchases} purchase documents. Credit notes subtract.

settings.desc: Company, taxes, numbering, payments and roles.
settings.taxIdHelp: Shown on invoices. CUIT and RFC are checked.
settings.logoHelp: PNG or JPG up to 2 MB. It appears on the PDF, the email and the public invoice.
settings.countryHelp: Sets the chart of accounts, tax rates and numbering. Base currency: {currency}. It can only change before the first document.
settings.taxesHelp: Rates you can pick on each line. Rates already used can't change their percentage: create a new one.
settings.seriesHelp: Each series has its own numbering. Numbers only go forward.
settings.seriesHelpAr: One series per letter and point of sale (punto de venta). Books picks A, B or C from your VAT condition and the customer's.
settings.remindersOn: Email customers when an invoice is overdue
settings.reminderHelp: Up to five reminders, separated by commas.
settings.lockHelp: No entries can be posted on or before this date. Use it after you close a month or file taxes.
settings.paymentsHelp: Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again. Only owners and admins see this tab.
settings.keepSecret: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.webhookUrl: Webhook URL to add in the provider:
settings.rotateHelp: If the URL leaked, create a new one. Then update it in Stripe and Mercado Pago.
settings.einvoiceHonest: Today only the test provider works end to end. The ARCA (AFIP), SAT CFDI and Invopop connectors are not implemented yet: you can store their credentials, but authorizing with them returns an error.
settings.providerPending: This connector is not implemented yet. Invoices can't be authorized with it.
settings.testProviderHelp: Returns a fake authorization code. Invoices authorized this way have no fiscal validity.
settings.einvoiceDocs: What each provider needs (certificates, CUIT, punto de venta, CSD) is in docs/books-einvoicing.md.
settings.rolesHelp: Roles sit on top of app access. Owners and admins are always accountants. Members start as viewers until you give them another role, and keep their role if they leave and come back.
settings.noPeople: Nobody else has Books in this workspace.
settings.shopAutoPost: Post paid Shop orders as invoices
settings.shopAutoPostHelp: Each paid order becomes an approved, paid invoice once. Only orders in your base currency.
settings.crmSync: Create new customers as CRM companies
settings.crmSyncHelp: Customers you create in Books also appear in the CRM, linked.
settings.lockAdminOnly: Only the owner and admins of the workspace can change the close date.

errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended or you don't have Books in this workspace.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errors.forbidden: Your Books role doesn't allow this.
errors.not_found: Not found. It may have been deleted.
errors.invalid_input: Check the fields and try again.
errors.account_in_use: That account has movements. Archive it instead.
errors.already_billed: This order already has a bill.
errors.already_received: Part of the order was received, so it can't be cancelled.
errors.amount_exceeds_due: The amount is more than what is due.
errors.bank_currency_must_be_base: Bank accounts use the base currency.
errors.base_currency_locked: The base currency can't change after the first entry.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this at the same time. Reload and try again.
errors.country_locked: The country can't change after the first document.
errors.direction_mismatch: Money in matches invoices and money out matches bills.
errors.document_posted: Approved documents can't be edited. Use a credit note or void it.
errors.duplicate_code: There is already an account with that code.
errors.duplicate_series: There is already a series with that letter and point of sale.
errors.einvoice_authorized_use_credit_note: It is authorized by the tax authority: correct it with a credit note.
errors.einvoice_in_progress: An authorization is already in progress.
errors.einvoice_not_configured: Choose an e-invoicing provider in Settings first.
errors.email_failed: The email could not be sent. Try again.
errors.email_required: The contact has no email. Add one.
errors.empty_document: Add at least one line with an amount.
errors.file_type_not_allowed: That file type is not allowed.
errors.storage_unavailable: File storage is not available right now.
errors.fx_rate_required: Set the exchange rate for that currency.
errors.has_payments: It has payments or credit notes. Remove them or issue a credit note.
errors.invalid_country: Use a two-letter country code, like AR.
errors.invalid_credit_target: The original invoice can't take a credit note.
errors.invalid_currency: Use a three-letter currency code, like ARS.
errors.invalid_doc_type: That action doesn't apply to this document.
errors.invalid_due_date: The due date can't be before the issue date.
errors.invalid_end_date: The end date must be after the next date.
errors.invalid_logo: Upload the logo as a file.
errors.invalid_payment: That payment can't be matched to this account.
errors.invalid_status: That can't be done in its current status.
errors.invalid_tax_id: The tax ID is not valid. Check the digits.
errors.invalid_tax: The tax can't be more than the total.
errors.missing_system_account: A required account is missing from the chart.
errors.mp_error: Mercado Pago didn't respond. Try again.
errors.mp_invalid_token: That Mercado Pago token is not valid.
errors.mp_invalid_webhook_secret: That webhook secret is not valid.
errors.not_payable: This invoice has nothing left to pay.
errors.nothing_due: Nothing is due on that document.
errors.number_already_used: That number was already used. Numbers only go forward.
errors.over_receipt: That is more than what was ordered.
errors.owner_is_accountant: The owner is always an accountant.
errors.payment_unavailable: Online payment is not available for this invoice.
errors.period_locked: Books is closed for that date. Change the close date in Settings.
errors.provider_error: The e-invoicing provider returned an error.
errors.provider_not_implemented: That e-invoicing connector is not implemented yet.
errors.provider_payment_refund_in_provider: Online payments are refunded in Stripe or Mercado Pago.
errors.public_link_revoked: The public link is revoked. Create a new one first.
errors.quote_already_invoiced: That quote already has an invoice.
errors.quote_not_sent: Only sent or accepted quotes can be invoiced.
errors.reverse_from_document: Entries from documents are corrected from the document.
errors.series_in_use: The series has documents: its letter and point of sale can't change.
errors.series_required: Create a numbering series in Settings first.
errors.stripe_invalid_key: That Stripe key is not valid.
errors.stripe_invalid_webhook_secret: That webhook secret is not valid.
errors.system_account: That account is used by automatic entries.
errors.tax_rate_in_use: That tax is used in documents. Create a new one instead.
errors.unbalanced: Debits and credits must be equal.
errors.ai_disabled: AI is not available in this workspace.
errors.quota_exceeded: Your workspace used its AI quota for the month.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute.
errors.already_credited: This invoice is already fully credited.
errors.credit_exceeds_invoice: The credit note is larger than what is left to credit on the invoice.
errors.next_date_in_past: The next date has to be today or later.
errors.not_a_member: That person is not a member of this workspace.

public.processing: We are confirming your payment. Reload in a minute.
public.payOffline: Pay with the instructions on the invoice.
